description: This file is a PHP source file defining the StoriesApiController class, which provides API endpoints for managing stories including upload, update, sorting, and listing functionalities within the Goteo project.

classes.name: StoriesApiController
classes.description: API controller for managing story entities, providing endpoints for CRUD operations, sorting, and image uploads.

methods.name: validateStory
methods.description: Validates and retrieves a story by ID, throwing exceptions if not authorized or not found.

methods.name: uploadImagesAction
methods.description: Handles AJAX image upload requests for stories, requires proper permissions.

methods.name: storiesPropertyAction
methods.description: Gets or updates a specific property of a story identified by ID, with permission checks.

methods.name: storiesSortAction
methods.description: Changes the order of a story based on user input.

methods.name: storiesAction
methods.description: Returns a list of stories, with optional filtering and pagination.
